No photo shows the power adapter, the exact adaptor issue, or any ports being tested.

read_from: photo 1 (controller layout/buttons and Xbox One console appearance)

claims.claim: Xbox one with one pad for sell

no photo shows game discs/cases or the FC game.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired
claims.evidence: no internal/serial/anti-tamper evidence shown; photos only show exterior.

claims.claim: original pads and the UK receipt
claims.evidence: no receipt photo shown; controller authenticity not provable from these images alone.

risks.risk: Adaptor/power problem may be more than just the adapter (e.g., console power input/PSU fault), which affects whether it can be used at all.
risks.proof: A short video showing the console powering on using the provided adapter (or a known-good adapter) plus a close-up of the power input while connected.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not reliably working / adapter fault (worst case).

risks.risk: Games may not be included, or may be missing/incorrect (FC specifically).
risks.proof: Clear photos of all 6 game discs/cases laid out, with FC visible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as console + controller only (no games).

risks.risk: Ports may be faulty (HDMI/USB/Ethernet), which can make the console unusable for normal play.
risks.proof: Video showing HDMI connected to a TV and at least one USB device/controller recognized; ideally show Ethernet link if claimed.
risks.if_unproven: Price as ports not guaranteed (worst case).

risks.risk: Controller may have drift/button issues not visible in a still photo.
risks.proof: Clip showing controller connected and working in-game/menu (movement + button presses) or a controller test screen.
risks.if_unproven: Price as controller condition unknown (worst case).

risks.risk: Console may have been opened/repaired or may have hidden faults not visible externally.
risks.proof: Photo of the console serial/label and a close-up of seals/underside; plus a power-on test video.

proof_requests: Video: power-on test using the provided adapter (or a known-good adapter) showing the console boots to dashboard.
Close-up photos of the power adapter and the console power input area (showing the claimed adaptor issue).
Photos of all included games (6 discs/cases) with FC clearly visible.
Video: HDMI output working on a TV and at least one USB port/controller recognition test.
Photo of the UK receipt (or receipt details) and controller model/label close-up.
response.reason: The photos confirm an Xbox One console with one controller, but the key differentiators (adapter issue details, included games, and port functionality) are not proven. So it should be priced at the worst case using the closest comparables for Xbox One with controller and power adapter, treating it as having an adapter-related problem and not assuming games/ports are fully functional.
